entries.description: Empirical performance measurements, comparative metrics, or quantitative evaluations.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Tokens/sec, inference latency, memory footprint, speed comparisons, hardware benchmarks.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Vague qualitative praise without measurable figures.

entries.description: Personal hands-on trial, direct usage observations, or practitioner notes.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Author describing their own setup, what worked/failed when they ran the code, personal lessons.

entries.description: In-depth account of deploying or using a technique or tool in a real-world setting.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Production deployments, real project retrospectives, operational hurdles.

entries.description: Step-by-step instructional guide or how-to walkthrough.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Numbered instructions, code walkthroughs explaining how to achieve a specific goal.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Pure opinion essays or high-level philosophical musings.

entries.description: A reasoned thesis, position, or debate point defending a claim.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Persuasive writing presenting premises and conclusions, counterarguments, or critique.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Simple news reporting or factual listings.

entries.description: Caveat, pitfall, security vulnerability, or deprecation notice.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Gotchas, security advisories, common failure modes, risk assessments.

entries.description: Release announcement, new project launch, or feature rollout.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Changelogs, product launches, version releases, event announcements.

entries.description: Showcase of an impressive, creative, or novel project, demo, tool, or build.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Open-source repositories, creative demos, hobby builds, novel software/hardware hacks, creative engineering.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Generic enterprise press releases or routine minor library patch updates.

entries.description: Primary dataset, collection of records, statistics, public ledger, or reference dataset.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Curated datasets, raw data tables, benchmark data dumps, public record repositories, statistics compilations.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Incidental citation of a single stat or data point in an article.
